get_model_analytics: get message counts per model filtered by date range and user group
get_user_analytics: get message counts and token usage per user with optional date and group filters
get_messages: query chat messages filtered by model ID, user ID, or chat ID with pagination
get_summary: get dashboard summary statistics including total messages, chats, models, and users
get_token_usage: get token usage aggregated by model with input, output, and total token counts
